name: smwblocks-no-carry-yoshi-pipe-caps
title: No Carry/Yoshi Pipe Caps
description:
Ever worried that players can glitch sprites through pipes? Worry no more! These pipe caps, unlike SMW's, won't let the player carry sprites or Yoshi to another level, making it impossible to have glitched sprites in the next level, similar to the pipes in NSMB.

Now you can have buzzy beetles, bob-ombs and other sprites with absolutely no problems. It also fixes problems with custom sprites as well.

This version now checks $7E:148F, so there are no exceptions.
